title: Chickens in the New Mown Hey
author: Tommy Linden
problems: Row 6 "partners start a hey - rights on ends, lefts in center - until robins meet the second time - robins ricochet second time" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins do not meet in the middle 2 times in this hey.
Row 6 "partners start a hey - rights on ends, lefts in center - until robins meet the second time - robins ricochet second time" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey needs a group of four.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
